'''March 2001 Seattle tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Broken Games, Seattle, WA on 10 March 2001. [[Douglas Harvilla]] won it. It is known from Douglas Harvilla's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1862">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-11-seattle-wa-3-10-01d1862/ seattle-wa-3-10-01], DeckTech (Douglas "Douglas" Harvilla, 11 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-11-seattle-wa-3-10-01d1862/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Broken Games, Seattle, WA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Douglas Harvilla]]
